issues.description: The problem statement's UML declares Stock.add(String) to return void, but both the template and the solution implement Stock.add(String) returning int. This mismatch between the UML in problem_statement.md and the actual code can confuse students about the expected behavior and return value of Stock.add.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the documentation and code consistent. Either change the UML in problem_statement.md to show +add(String): int (preferred, since template/solution already return int), or modify the template and solution implementations so Stock.add(String) returns void and adjust callers/tests accordingly.
